newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt central bank to issue 500 mln repo-bankers.
newsitem.headline: Egypt central bank to issue 500 mln repo-bankers.

text.p: The Central Bank of Egypt will offer bankers a 500 million pound repurchase deal for two weeks from Wednesday November 6, private sector bankers said on Tuesday.
They said the central bank was asking them to borrow against their treasury bills to inject liquidity in the market.
Some bankers said the repurchase rate would be linked to the central bank's discount rate of 13.5 percent but others said those offering the highest rates would get the money they need.
Last month, the central bank offered a similar 500 million pound repurchase agreement. Bankers said the offer failed to spark much interest.
